caption:

Sonnet 5.5 jumped from 10.3% to 70.6% on Terminal-Bench 4.0 (real command-line coding work) — same price as before, and it landed inside GitHub Copilot the same day.

→ live now on every paid Copilot plan

slides.title: Anthropic's new Sonnet just beat Opus 5.5 at real coding tasks.
slides.sub: Same price as before. Shipped in GitHub Copilot the same day.
slides.voiceover: Anthropic's new Sonnet just beat its own flagship model at coding.

slides.label: THE NUMBER
slides.title: Up from 10.3% on the same benchmark
slides.sub: Terminal-Bench 4.0 tests an AI agent on real, multi-step command-line coding work. Sonnet 5.5's score beats Opus 5.5's on this one.
slides.voiceover: On real terminal coding tasks, it jumped from 10 percent to over 70.

slides.label: WHAT CHANGED
slides.title: Sonnet 5.5 in three numbers
items: Up to 30% lower, at the same per-token price
slides.voiceover: It's over 30 percent faster and cheaper per task, with a 1 million token context window.

slides.label: SONNET 5 VS 5.5
slides.title: What actually moved
slides.voiceover: Same price on both, but a massive jump in coding score and speed.

slides.label: SAME DAY
slides.title: It's already inside GitHub Copilot
steps: Generally available, not a preview — launched the same day as Sonnet 5.5 itself
VS Code, Visual Studio, JetBrains, Xcode, GitHub.com, Copilot CLI — on Pro, Pro+, Business and Enterprise plans
Pick `Claude Sonnet 5.5` from the model switcher — on by default unless an admin turned it off
slides.voiceover: It's already live in GitHub Copilot, on every paid plan, in most major editors.

slides.label: WHERE IT FITS
slides.title: Sonnet 5.5 vs. Opus 5.5: Anthropic's own split
items: Well-scoped everyday tasks, fixing bugs, polished documents and spreadsheets
Complex work that needs careful judgment
A Claude Haiku 5.5, Anthropic says, in the coming weeks
slides.voiceover: Anthropic's own advice: Sonnet for everyday tasks, Opus for the hard judgment calls.

slides.title: Same price.
lines: `claude-sonnet-5-5` on the API, or just open Claude
your Copilot model switcher — it may already be there
slides.voiceover: Same price, a very different model — check your Copilot model switcher today.
